text.zh: 35 岁，黄昏将至。忠诚如你，谢幕方式是……
text.en: 35, dusk falling. Loyal to the last, you bow out by…

label.zh: 回到母队，以队长身份退役，全场起立
label.en: Return home, retire as captain, the whole stadium rising

label.zh: 巅峰急流勇退，留下完美背影
label.en: Walk away at your peak, a perfect silhouette

text.zh: 35 岁，黄昏将至。你的谢幕方式是……
text.en: 35, dusk falling. You bow out by…

label.zh: 战至 40 岁，还在五大联赛进球
label.en: Play till 40, still scoring in a top league

label.zh: 巅峰急流勇退，留下完美背影
label.en: Walk away at your peak, a perfect silhouette

label.zh: 去远方联赛养老，顺便领一份高薪
label.en: Cash a fat cheque winding down in a faraway league
